items.issue: Case-folding ancestor alias lets an accepted archive write outside dest: A -> . plus a member named a/../outside/secret.txt passes validation, and the manual no-filter path then mkdirs through dest/a, which case-folds onto dest/A -> ., so .. climbs out of dest and the payload lands beside it (reproduced at a8347f3 on a case-insensitive filesystem). The filter path keeps it inside, so it is also a parity break.
items.reason: Critical severity, always: deferred record is the audit trail for the cycle it was raised. It is also entered as a fix row and carries the cycle-1 rework design, because a CRITICAL blocks until it is fixed.
